answer: A bond is refunded only after 28 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The ridge counter is kept in signal and river shows each reset. Anyone hence has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 28 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 4699 identities would post 2475 proofs and burn roughly 71 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
